sloka: सकामा भव कैकेयि विधवा राज्यम् आवस ।कण्टकाक्रमण क्लान्तावनमद्य गमिष्यति ॥२-४२-१९॥
transliteration: sakāmā bhava kaikeyi vidhavā rājyam āvasa ।kaṇṭakākramaṇa klāntāvanamadya gamiṣyati ॥2-42-19॥

translations.english: Sita, beloved daughter of Janaka, who is accustomed to comforts, will now wander in the forest troubled by piercing thorns.
